agents.title: Agent definitions
agents.subtitle: Give each specialist a model, instructions and a deliberate tool boundary.
agents.name: Name

agents.toolsHint: Comma-separated registered tool names. Empty means no tools.
agents.secrets: Never enter API keys or credentials in prompts or tool arguments. Configure providers on the server.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.subtitle: Compose a path from a question to a considered answer. Connect reasoning, knowledge, tools and human judgment.
workflows.name: Workflow name
workflows.emptyHint: Start with a connected start and end. Add steps, connect their handles, then save and run.
workflows.confirmDelete: Delete this workflow? This cannot be undone.
workflows.inspectorHint: Select a node to configure it. Drag from an output handle to an input handle to connect steps. Select an edge and press Delete to disconnect.
workflows.canvasHint: Drag to arrange · Connect handles · Delete to remove · Scroll to zoom
workflows.invalidJson: Arguments must be a valid JSON object.
workflows.startHint: The run input enters the graph here. Exactly one start node is required.
workflows.endHint: The previous step becomes the final output. End nodes have no outgoing connections.
workflows.templateHint: Use {input} for the run input and {previous} for the previous step output.
workflows.noSecrets: Do not put credentials in node configuration. Tools and providers are configured on the server.
workflows.saveBeforeRun: Save a valid graph before running. Runs always execute the persisted version.
workflows.runHint: Runs execute on the server. Results below are loaded from persisted run records.
workflows.historyHint: Inspect persisted inputs, outputs and each executed node.
workflows.selectRun: Select a run to inspect its node results.
workflows.approvalHint: Review paused workflow runs. Only administrators can approve or reject.
workflows.adminRequired: An administrator must decide. This run stays paused until then.
workflows.agentsUnavailable: Agent definitions could not be loaded

validation.end: Add at least one end node.
validation.duplicate: Node and edge identifiers must be unique.
validation.branches: Conditions need exactly one True and one False connection.
validation.outgoing: Each step needs one outgoing connection; end nodes need none.
validation.config: Complete the prompt, query, tool name and valid node configuration.
validation.cycle: Cycles are not supported. Remove the circular connection.
validation.unreachable: Every node must be reachable from Start.
validation.name: Enter a workflow name.
validation.json: Fix the invalid arguments JSON before saving.
validation.limits: Use 2–50 nodes, at most 100 edges and a workflow smaller than 128 KB.

metadata.title: AegisAI — Production AI Knowledge Workspace
metadata.description: Document ingestion, hybrid retrieval, grounded RAG chat, policy-gated agents, evaluation and observability — one calm workspace.

landing.badge: Self-hosted · Deny-by-default · Built to be audited
landing.subtitle: AegisAI ingests your files, indexes them for hybrid search, and answers questions with citations — behind a policy gate that records every decision.
landing.pipelineDesc: Every request travels the same guarded path — nothing reaches an action without passing the gate.

gateway.name: Gateway
gateway.desc: FastAPI with JWT auth, RBAC and rate limiting. Every call carries a trace id.

context.name: Context
context.desc: Conversation history plus retrieved, citation-ready passages from Qdrant.

reasoning.name: Reasoning
reasoning.desc: OpenAI-compatible LLMs or a local llama.cpp server — one provider abstraction.

policy.name: Policy gate
policy.desc: Deny by default. Role, allowlist and constraints checked; every verdict audited.

execution.name: Guarded execution
execution.desc: Actions run from a strict registry of typed tools — no free-form execution.

verify.name: Verify
verify.desc: Schema and business-rule validation with retry-and-feedback repair loops.

observe.name: Observe
observe.desc: Langfuse traces, golden-dataset evaluations, quality gates in CI.

ingest.name: Document ingestion
ingest.desc: Upload PDF, DOCX, Markdown or text — extraction, chunking and embedding run through a Celery worker.

chat.name: Streaming RAG chat
chat.desc: Token-by-token SSE answers with a trace id on every response, so anything you read can be traced.

searchReady.name: Hybrid index
searchReady.desc: Dense + sparse vectors in a single Qdrant collection with RRF fusion — search UX lands next.

auth.name: Auth & RBAC
auth.desc: Access/refresh JWT rotation, admin/user/agent roles, per-route dependencies.

policy.name: Policy audit trail
policy.desc: An immutable table records every allow/deny with actor, action and reason.

local.name: Local-first models
local.desc: Run quantized GGUF models on 4GB of VRAM, or point at any OpenAI-compatible API.

landing.roadmapDesc: Built one verified phase at a time — checkmarks follow passing tests, not intentions.

p1.title: Gateway & security
p1.desc: DB, users, JWT, RBAC, rate limits

p3.desc: LLM provider abstraction, local GGUF serving, SSE streaming

p4.title: Agent harness
p4.desc: Context builder, action registry, policy gate, verifier

p5.title: Agentic runtime
p5.desc: LangGraph loops, MCP tools, human-in-the-loop approvals

p6.title: Evaluation
p6.desc: Faithfulness & recall metrics, quality gates in CI
